senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be cut off, be gone. Tanḥ. Haăz. 7 (play on נח̇ב̇י בן ופ̇ס̇י, Num. XIII, 14) החב̇יא האמת ופַ֗סָּ֗ה האמונה מפיו he hid the truth, and faith was gone from his mouth.
to cut into stripes, divide, v. פַּס.
to distribute (with the shovel, v. פַּס ch. 4).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 1:5">Tosef. Ukts. I, 5</cite> <he>תבואה שפְּסָסָהּ בגורן</he> (Var. ed. Zuck. <he>שנִפְסְסָה</he>) grain which one distributed in the barn (forming separate piles).
<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:5">Ukts. I, 5</cite> <he>שפְּסָסָן</he> Ar. s. v. <cite ref="Q01345"><he>פספס</he></cite> (v. <cite ref="B01007"><he>בָּסַס</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> [read:] <he>והיה פוֹסְסָן מן הצד</he> and he shovelled them (the excrements) sideways (out into the water); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 54:1">Yalk. ib. 54</cite> <he>והיה פותחין</he> (corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="S00843"><he>קָטָרַקְטִין</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to distribute, spread; ה׳ מורסא to distribute an ulcer by manipulation, to pass over with the hand (פַּס).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 2:5">Eduy. II, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Eduyot 1:8">Tosef. ib. I, 8</cite> <he>המֵיפֵיס מורסא וכ׳</he> he who manipulates an abscess on the Sabbath, if for the purpose (of peeling or) of making a head to it as the physicians do &c.; <cite ref="Shabbat 107b">Sabb. 107ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
